short_description: Premium self-guided adventure motorcycle rentals for exploring Yellowstone, Cody, and the Beartooth Highway at your own pace.
description:
This is a self-guided adventure motorcycle rental for experienced riders.

You will receive a professionally maintained ADV motorcycle, safety briefing, and local route recommendations. Riders explore at their own pace with no guide included.

Rental includes:
• Motorcycle
• Basic orientation
• Route recommendations
• Emergency contact support

Not included:
• Guide
• Fuel 
• Riding gear (available separately)

A valid motorcycle endorsement and experience with ADV motorcycles is required.

what_is_included_items.value: Premium adventure motorcycle rental (Kawasaki KLR 650 / 650S or Yamaha Ténéré 700)
Complimentary delivery and pickup within the greater Cody, WY area
Most riding gear included (helmet, jacket, gloves) – limited sizes and quantities available
Riding or hiking boots (ankle-covering footwear required; no street shoes or sneakers)
Local area orientation and riding recommendations
Tools, first aid kit and extra tubes

what_is_not_included:
+ Optional supplemental insurance: $15 per day (through MBA)

+ Motorcycle boots: limited sizes and quantities available; guests   are strongly encouraged to bring their own ankle-covering riding or hiking boots if proper fit cannot be provided
itinerary:
Suggested Itinerary (Self-Guided)

1. Pickup & Orientation – Cody, WY
Meet in Cody for motorcycle delivery, paperwork, and a safety briefing. Bike setup, fit check, and local riding overview included.

2. Recommended Loop Selection
Choose from two curated self-guided loops, each designed as a full 6+ hour riding day, depending on rider preference, weather, and conditions:

 Yellowstone Loop – Scenic highways, elevation changes, wildlife areas, and iconic views

Beartooth Loop – High-alpine riding, sweeping curves, dramatic elevation, and optional mild dirt/gravel sections

3. Self-Guided Ride at Your Own Pace
Ride independently with flexibility for stops, photos, meals, and fuel. Routes are designed for experienced riders who want freedom without a rigid schedule.

4. Return & Pickup
Motorcycle pickup at the agreed location in Cody or surrounding area. Post-ride check and wrap-up.
highlights:
Ride some of the most scenic and diverse motorcycle roads in the American West, starting from Cody, Wyoming. These self-guided routes feature dramatic elevation changes, sweeping mountain highways, expansive views, and access to legendary riding areas near Yellowstone and the Beartooth Mountains.

Enjoy the freedom of a self-guided experience with carefully selected adventure motorcycles that are well maintained, properly set up, and suited for long days in changing conditions. Each bike is inspected and prepared before your ride to ensure reliability, comfort, and confidence throughout the day.

This experience is designed for riders who value flexibility and independence. Ride at your own pace, choose your stops, and take in the scenery without the pressure of a group schedule. Whether you prefer smooth pavement, twisty mountain roads, or light dirt and gravel sections, these routes offer a balanced and rewarding ADV ride.

Local knowledge is built into the experience. You’ll receive area orientation, riding recommendations, and insight into road conditions, fuel stops, and must-see viewpoints—helping you make the most of your time in the region.

special_requirements:
Special Requirements

+Riders must hold a valid motorcycle license or motorcycle endorsement in their home country or state.
+International riders must present a valid passport and either:
+An international motorcycle license or
+A valid foreign motorcycle license (in English or accompanied by  an International Driving Permit).

+Additional motorcycle insurance is required and must be purchased separately through MBA Insurance at $15 per day.

+We will provide the Make & VIN number for the assigned motorcycle so riders can complete the MBA insurance purchase.

+Insurance setup can be completed in advance or on the morning of pickup if needed.

+Riders must be comfortable operating a mid-to-large displacement adventure motorcycle and riding independently for extended periods.
restrictions:
This experience is not suitable for beginners or first-time motorcycle riders. Riders must have prior on-road motorcycle experience.

Participants must be physically able to safely mount, dismount, balance, and control a mid-to-large displacement adventure motorcycle for extended periods.

Riders must be comfortable riding in changing weather conditions, including cold mornings, wind, rain, and varying road surfaces.

Routes may reach high elevations (8,000–11,000+ feet above sea level), which can affect breathing, stamina, hydration, and overall physical performance.

This experience is not recommended for individuals who are not acclimated to altitude or who have medical conditions that may be affected by high elevation, including heart, lung, or circulation-related conditions.

Participants should be aware that altitude sickness is possible and are responsible for monitoring their own physical condition throughout the ride.

Pregnant riders are strongly discouraged from participating.

Riders under the influence of alcohol, drugs, or impairing medications will not be permitted to ride and will forfeit the rental without refund.

Height and weight limitations may apply due to motorcycle size and seat height. Please contact us in advance with any concerns.
extras:
Health & Safety

Safety is our top priority. All rides are led by an experienced professional guide and follow a controlled, safety-focused pace.

Riders must follow the guide’s instructions at all times. Unsafe riding behavior may result in removal from the tour without refund.

Routes travel through remote and mountainous terrain, where weather can change rapidly. Conditions may include cold temperatures, wind, rain, and sudden storms.

Rides may reach high elevations exceeding 8,000–11,000+ feet, which can impact breathing, hydration, energy levels, and overall physical performance.

Participants are responsible for monitoring their own physical condition and notifying the guide immediately if they feel unwell, fatigued, dizzy, or experience symptoms of altitude sickness.

Wildlife encounters are common in this region, including bison, elk, deer, and other animals. Riders must maintain safe distances and follow all wildlife safety protocols.

Cell service may be limited or unavailable in certain areas. Emergency communication equipment and first-aid supplies are carried by the guide.

Helmets are mandatory. Additional riding gear is provided when available; however, gear sizing and quantities are limited.

Riders must wear sturdy footwear (motorcycle boots or over-the-ankle hiking/riding boots). Open-toe shoes, sneakers, or casual footwear are not permitted.

Alcohol, recreational drugs, or impairing medications are strictly prohibited before or during the ride.

By participating, riders acknowledge the inherent risks of motorcycle travel and agree to ride within their personal limits.
disclaimers:
Routes, destinations, and ride timing may be adjusted or modified due to weather, road conditions, construction, wildlife activity, group ability, mechanical issues, or safety considerations.

Yellowstone Adventure Moto is not responsible for delays, route changes, or cancellations caused by circumstances beyond our control, including but not limited to weather, park or road closures, wildfires, accidents, or acts of nature.

Mechanical issues, flat tires, or unexpected breakdowns may occur despite proper maintenance. While reasonable assistance will be provided, delays or early termination of a ride may be necessary for safety.

Wildlife sightings are unpredictable and cannot be guaranteed. Encounters may result in delays or rerouting.

Cell phone service may be limited or unavailable in remote areas. Emergency response times may be longer due to location and terrain.

Riders are responsible for their personal belongings, including cameras, phones, and riding gear.

Yellowstone Adventure Moto is not responsible for discomfort related to weather changes, altitude effects, fatigue, or personal physical limitations.

Participation in this activity involves inherent risks associated with motorcycle travel in mountainous and remote environments. By booking, participants acknowledge and accept these risks.
